description: ADR-0352 §7 (phase 5b): the server-defined golden portfolio an approver's behavioural-diff backtest must run over to count as having seen a change. Looked up ONLY by the offering's product code (no currency fallback: a product without its own entry has no approval backtest and cannot be approved). Each portfolio is the product's golden scenario account plus the shared sample accounts of its currency; ReferenceProductsTest holds every reference product to an entry. product-catalog packages this directory; obp diff takes the same files.
